title: Java Exception Handling
intro: Java exceptions (fresher level) introduces the error-handling model. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the exception hierarchy (Throwable → Error/Exception → RuntimeException), then checked vs unchecked (the debate every fresher must understand). Try-catch-finally and throw/throws follow at the mechanics tier, then try-with-resources (the modern cleanup pattern). Custom exceptions and common runtime exceptions are the applied tier, then exception best practices close the module.
